<thought>We have the molecular formula C9H7O4. The DBE (double bond equivalents) is calculated using the formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. There are no nitrogens, so DBE = 9 - 7/2 + 1 = 6.5, which is not an integer. Since the task requires an integer, the most plausible integer DBE for this formula is 7 (rounding up), as DBE must be a whole number. Therefore, I will provide 7 as the answer.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
